mechanics.title: Damage Surface
mechanics.description: Generic surface that damages you each time you touch it.

mechanics.title: Damage Volume
mechanics.description: Poison/heat cloud that damages you on tick.

mechanics.title: Falling-Rock Markers
mechanics.description: A red marker fills the impact area before rocks land.

mechanics.title: Ice Storm System
mechanics.description: Periodically applies frost damage while active; you can take cover. (Instanced by Glacier.)

mechanics.title: Environmental Hazard Framework
mechanics.description: Base system for big biome set-pieces — avalanches, rising lava, typhoons. (Instanced per biome.)
